name: MyCareersFuture
what_its_for: Government job board with SG salary data and skills matching
notes: Start here for SG roles; listings show which skills employers ask for.

name: LinkedIn Jobs
what_its_for: Roles plus the people already doing them, useful for seeing real career paths
notes: Set alerts for target-role titles rather than browsing.

name: Indeed Singapore
what_its_for: Broad SG listings including SME and contract roles
notes: Good coverage of roles that never reach LinkedIn.

name: JobStreet Singapore
what_its_for: Established SG board, strong in ops, finance and admin roles
notes: Widely used by local employers outside tech.

name: Glints
what_its_for: Startup and scale-up roles across SEA
notes: Skews younger and to startups; good for switchers wanting range.

name: e2i (Employment and Employability Institute)
what_its_for: Career coaching, job fairs and place-and-train programmes
notes: Walk-in career advice; useful for mid-career switchers.

name: Careers Connect
what_its_for: One-to-one career guidance from WSG advisers
notes: Book a session before committing to a switch.

name: Singapore Computer Society
what_its_for: Tech professional body: events, certification, community
notes: Student and professional membership tiers.

name: Google Developer Groups Singapore
what_its_for: Developer meetups, talks and workshops
notes: Low-commitment way to meet people doing the role you want.

name: Tech in Asia
what_its_for: SEA tech news, funding rounds and job listings
notes: Useful for spotting which companies are hiring before roles post.

name: Hack & Roll
what_its_for: Beginner-friendly 24-hour hackathon
notes: Portfolio project in a weekend; open beyond NUS students.

name: DSTA BrainHack
what_its_for: AI and cyber challenges run by DSTA
notes: Strong signal on a CV for AI-adjacent roles.

name: SGInnovate
what_its_for: Deep-tech talks, workshops and hiring events
notes: Best single source for AI and deep-tech events in SG.

name: Singapore FinTech Festival
what_its_for: Where finance and technology hiring conversations happen
notes: Check for free community or student passes.

name: Institute of Banking and Finance
what_its_for: Finance skills framework, certification and funded training
notes: IBF-accredited courses often carry higher subsidy.

name: Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants
what_its_for: Accountancy body: CPD, events and career resources
notes: Relevant for finance roles moving toward analysis and advisory.

name: Marketing Institute of Singapore
what_its_for: Marketing professional body: courses, events, accreditation
notes: Useful for marketers formalising strategy skills.

name: A*STAR
provider: Agency for Science Technology and Research
what_its_for: Research careers, attachments and scientific events
notes: Entry point for research and science-adjacent roles.

name: Science Centre Singapore
what_its_for: Science festivals, public science events and outreach roles
notes: Includes the annual Singapore Science Festival.

name: Meetup Singapore
what_its_for: Local interest groups across data, finance, marketing and tech
notes: Search by the skill you're learning, not your job title.
